John Michael “Johnny” Gaudreau was born on August 13, 1993, in Salem, New Jersey. He emerged as a standout in Boston College’s storied  hockey program between 2011 and 2014, where he helped the Eagles secure a national championship as a freshman in 2012 and earned back-to-back  Hockey East Player of the Year honors.

In his junior year, he received the prestigious Hobey Baker Award as the NCAA’s top player, setting the stage for an exceptional professional career.

Johnny Gaudreau’s Career

Johnny Gaudreau carved out a remarkable 11-season NHL career as an agile left winger, first with the Calgary Flames, then with the Columbus Blue Jackets. Drafted in the fourth round (104th overall) in 2011, he overcame skeptics with his size, skill, and relentless determination.

Game
game

During his first full NHL season (2014–15), Gaudreau dazzled with 24 goals in 80  games, earned a spot in the NHL All-Star Game, was named to the All-Rookie Team, and became a Calder Trophy finalist. He also received Rookie of the Month twice and was recognized as a First Star of the Week.

His finesse, creativity, and poised playmaking earned him the Lady Byng Memorial Trophy in 2016–17, awarded to the league’s most gentlemanly player. Over the course of his career, Johnny reached seven NHL All-Star selections—a testament to his sustained elite performance.

Statistically, he posted 243 goals and 500 assists in 763 NHL games, with a plus-minus of +25. His productivity peaked in the 2021–22 season, where he notched a career-high 115 points.

Plan Finances

As a Calgary Flame, Johnny Gaudreau ranks among the franchise’s top contributors—5th in both assists (399) and points (609), and 5th in even-strength goals and game-winning goals.

His offensive prowess was also vital in international play; he holds the U.S. all-time scoring record at the World Championships, totaling 43 points (13 goals, 30 assists).

Notable Career Highlights

  • Boston College: National title (2012), Hobey Baker Award (2014), consecutive Hockey East Player of the Year
  • NHL Debut (2014–15): 24 goals, All-Star, All-Rookie Team, Calder finalist
  • Career Stats: 243 goals, 500 assists, +25, 763 games
  • Awards: Lady Byng Trophy (2017), seven-time All-Star
  • Calgary Flames Rankings: 5th in assists, points, even-strength goals, game-winning goals
  • International: U.S. all-time World Championship scoring leader

In 2022, Johnny Gaudreau signed with the Columbus Blue Jackets, where he played his final two seasons while remaining an influential and charismatic figure both on and off the ice. His legacy extends beyond stats—he symbolized the dream of smaller players thriving at the highest level of hockey.

Personal Life

Johnny Gaudreau was deeply family-oriented. He was married to Meredith, and together they had two children, Noa and Johnny, with their third child, Carter Michael, born on April 1, 2025, seven months after the brothers’ tragic passing.

Johnny and his younger brother, Matthew, were fatally struck by a suspected drunk driver on August 29, 2024, while cycling in New Jersey, just a day before their sister’s wedding. The tragedy sent waves of grief through the hockey world and beyond.

Matthew Gaudreau’s Bio: Age, Career, Stats, Wife, Net Worth

Early Life & Education

Matthew Gaudreau, born December 5, 1994, in Carneys Point Township, New Jersey, grew up immersed in the region’s vibrant hockey culture.

He and his brother Johnny developed their early skills at Hollydell Ice Arena before attending Gloucester Catholic High School in Gloucester City, New Jersey, where both starred on the ice.

Matthew then pursued collegiate hockey at Boston College, appearing in 119 games and tallying 16 goals with 44 assists, showcasing his consistent two-way play and team-first mindset.

Matthew Gaudreau’s Career

Matthew Gaudreau enjoyed a dedicated hockey career that spanned a range of competitive levels, including U.S. college, minor pro leagues, and coaching at the high school level.

After his impactful tenure at Boston College, where he notched 16 goals and 44 assists over 119 games, he transitioned to pursuing professional opportunities across the AHL, ECHL, and abroad.

Following his college days, Matthew played for several AHL and ECHL teams, including the Worcester Railers, Reading Royals, and Bridgeport Sound Tigers.

These stints helped solidify his reputation as a reliable contributor at the minor league level. While his brother Johnny rose to star status in the NHL, Matthew forged his own path marked by grit and community involvement.

After stepping away from the rink as a player, Matthew turned to coaching, becoming the head coach of Gloucester Catholic High School’s hockey team—his alma mater.

He held that role through at least the 2023–24 season, guiding the next generation of players and investing in youth development. His influence as a coach resonated deeply, especially in southern New Jersey’s tight-knit hockey community.

Though Matthew Gaudreau’s career didn’t yield headline stats like those of elite NHL players, his steady presence on the ice and his off-ice dedication spoke volumes. USA Hockey reflected on his post-playing contributions with admiration:

“Matt forged his own journey… That family has done so much for youth hockey. The way kids feel in this area about this sport is because of the Gaudreaus.”

There’s no widely published data on cumulative goals, assists, or game totals in minor league stats. However, his four-year college record and years of pro-level and coaching service underscore a substantial and meaningful hockey life.

Matthew’s commitment—to the sport, to mentorship, and to his local community—defined his career more than point totals ever could. He lived the game in a way that left an indelible mark, especially for young players following in his footsteps.

Notable Stats & Highlights

  • Boston College: 119 games—16 goals, 44 assists
  • Coached Gloucester Catholic High School through the 2023–24 season
  • Community legacy acknowledged by USA Hockey

Personal Life

Matthew Gaudreau’s personal life was anchored in a deep, long-term relationship with his wife, Madeline. The couple dated for nearly 15 years before marrying in July 2021, after Matthew proposed in July 2019. In August 2024, Madeline was expecting their first child, due in December.

Tragically, Matthew died on August 29, 2024, and Madeline gave birth four months later on December 29, naming their son Tripp Matthew. Their relationship and enduring bond were widely celebrated by family and fans alike.

Net Worth

Estimates of Matthew Gaudreau’s net worth vary. One source approximates it at around $800,000 at the time of his passing, reflecting earnings from his professional hockey career across minor leagues.

Another speculative figure suggests a higher valuation of around $5–10 million, but this appears unverified and is likely less reliable. The $800,000 estimate is considered more grounded in his known playing and coaching tenure.

Kelley Kuhr is best known as the longtime partner of actor Malcolm McDowell, rather than being a widely publicized public figure herself. Hence, public information about her personal background is limited.

Early Life & Education

Detailed information on Kelley Kuhr’s early life and education isn’t publicly available. What we do know is that she established herself as a successful designer, earning admiration and respect from Malcolm McDowell.

Their partnership reflects a shared creative spirit, with Kuhr’s design talents complementing McDowell’s film legacy in a deeply meaningful way.

While specifics on her upbringing remain private, her impact through design and personal presence is clear from her long-standing marriage and collaborations.

Kelley Kuhr’s Career

Kelley Kuhr is a talented designer whose work and presence have clearly left a lasting impression on those around her. Though she operates outside the spotlight of Hollywood, her creative influence shines through in the admiration voiced by her husband, actor Malcolm McDowell.

In a recent PEOPLE interview, McDowell referred to her as “a brilliant designer,” offering a glimpse into her craft and creative ambition.

At the time of their conversation, Kuhr was working on a standout project described by McDowell as her “masterpiece”: a house in Mexico.

He expressed pride and awe, calling the accomplishment “an amazing thing that she’s done.” That single reference hints at her capability to handle large-scale, high-impact design projects that blend aesthetic sensibility with personal significance.

Despite working in different fields, Kuhr in design and McDowell in acting, they share common passions. McDowell highlighted their mutual love for collecting and antique hunting as a formative part of their life together. He told PEOPLE:

“We collect stuff … we pretty much collect and like the same stuff, which is lucky … a lot of fun … always [go] straight to the antique shops and hunting around and having fun that way. It’s great.”

That shared hobby underscores a collaborative spirit rooted in mutual appreciation—not just for objects, but for the joy of discovery and the experience of doing things together. Such practices can be as essential to artistic inspiration as they are to the harmony of a long-lasting partnership.

Overall, Kelley Kuhr’s career highlights may not dominate headlines, but through McDowell’s reflections, a clear portrait emerges: a creative professional whose passion and achievements are deeply respected by those closest to her, and whose collaborative life with McDowell is built on respect, mutual joy, and shared creative energy.

Personal Life

Kelley Kuhr and Malcolm McDowell married in 1991, marking over three decades of partnership. McDowell credits their enduring relationship to mutual respect and genuinely enjoying each other’s company—rather than grand romantic gestures. They share three sons: Beckett (21), Finn (18), and Seamus (16).

The couple’s bond extends into family life, where McDowell frequently speaks affectionately about their grandchildren, including the newest addition, Tove, the daughter of their son Charlie and Lily Collins, calling her “absolutely beautiful.”

Net Worth

Public information about Kelley Kuhr’s net worth is not readily available. As a designer and longtime partner to a celebrated actor, her financial profile remains private.

While her husband’s net worth is sometimes speculated on, Kuhr’s own professional and personal influence rests more in creative recognition than in public monetary figures.
